how: Manual pilot pass (Claude Code, 2026-11-09). 'primary' = the figure was read from the official document's own text; 'secondary' = reported by a search summary of the official site that could not be fetched automatically (ssa.gov blocks automated requests), so check it by hand; 'pending' = not published yet; 'statutory' = fixed by law, not indexed. NOTHING here is used by the app yet: the tax engines still compute with 2026 figures until the tables are switched on 2027-01-01.

items.summary: MFJ $33,200; head of household $24,925; single and married filing separately $16,600. Age-65/blind add-on $1,700 ($2,100 if unmarried).
0% rate up to $102,100 MFJ / $51,050 single / $68,350 HOH; 15% rate up to $633,600 MFJ / $563,200 single / $598,400 HOH; 20% above.
3.8% NIIT and its MAGI thresholds ($200,000 single / $250,000 MFJ) are set by statute and are not indexed: no change.

2027 applicable percentages (initial-final): under 133% FPL 2.15%; 133-150% 3.23-4.3%; 150-200% 4.3-6.78%; 200-250% 6.78-8.66%; 250-300% 8.66-10.22%; 300-400% 10.22%. Employer-coverage affordability (required contribution) 10.22%.
items.caveat: These are the statutory indexing results. Whether enhanced subsidies exist for 2027 is a legislative question this table does not answer.

items.summary: Coverage year 2027 uses the 2026 HHS poverty guidelines (published 2026-01-15), 48 states + DC: 1 person $15,960; 2 $21,640; 3 $27,320; 4 $33,000; 5 $38,680; 6 $44,360; 7 $50,040; 8 $55,720; +$5,680 each additional person. Alaska 1 person $19,950; Hawaii $18,360.
items.source: HHS Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines, Federal Register 2026-00755

items.summary: Basic exclusion amount $15,480,000 for 2027 (also the GST exemption).
Annual gift exclusion $20,000 per donee for 2027 (up from $19,000); gifts to a non-citizen spouse $201,000.
COLA 3.6% (announced 2026-10-01); taxable maximum $192,300 (2026: $184,500). Reported by a search summary of ssa.gov; the SSA pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so confirm on ssa.gov.
Earnings-test exempt amounts for 2027: $25,560 (under full retirement age) and $67,920 (year reaching it). Reported by a search summary; confirm on ssa.gov.
PIA bend points for people first eligible in 2027: $1,340 and $8,077 (90% / 32% / 15%). Reported by a search summary of ssa.gov/oact; confirm there.
items.source: SSA Office of the Chief Actuary, PIA formula

items.summary: Social Security benefit-taxation thresholds ($25,000/$34,000 single; $32,000/$44,000 joint) are set by statute and not indexed: no change.

CMS has not published the official 2027 Part B premium and IRMAA brackets yet (usually mid-to-late November). Trustees-report and press projections exist; they are estimates, so none is recorded here.
items.source: CMS Medicare Part B premiums and deductibles announcement

items.summary: HSA 2027 is published (Rev. Proc. 2026-24): self-only $4,500, family $9,000; HDHP minimum deductible $1,750 / $3,500; out-of-pocket maximum $8,700 / $17,400. The 401(k), 415(c) and IRA limits for 2027 are NOT published yet (the IRS notice usually appears mid-November; last year's came on 2025-11-13); projections exist but are not recorded.
items.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-24 (HSA); IRS annual retirement-plan COLA notice (pending)
